title: lines/<id>.jsonc
description: One line of units (game design 2.2 and 2.4). Whole numbers are bare; a number with a fraction is text, such as "2.6".

id.description: The line's ID. It must equal the file name and be in the roster in rules.jsonc.

primary.description: The track whose tier T unlocks the chassis of epoch T.

secondary.description: The track whose tier T - 1 is also needed for the chassis of epoch T.

built_at.description: The structure that builds this line, from the roster in rules.jsonc.

spacing.description: Least distance between unit centers at rest, in tiles.

build_seconds.description: Build time in seconds. It must be a whole number of ticks.

counters.description: Damage multipliers by target: a line ID from the roster, or "structures" for every structure.

chassis.description: The line's model for each epoch, by rising epoch.

attack.description: Keys of the line's attack that this chassis replaces. If it changes the kind, the line's range, projectile speed, minimum range and blast radius are not carried over.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.

number.description: A whole number, or text in plain decimal notation such as "2.6". A bare number with a fraction is not accepted, so that every value is read exactly.

kind.description: A ranged attack needs a range and a projectile speed, and may have a minimum range and a blast radius. A melee attack has none of the four.

interval_seconds.description: Seconds between attacks. It must be a whole number of ticks.

min_range.description: Targets closer than this many tiles cannot be fired at. It must be below the range.

blast_radius.description: Every enemy within this many tiles of the target takes the full damage of a hit.

projectile_speed.description: How fast a shot flies, in tiles per second.
